messages:
Sara (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Saturday Aug 21 were running a voluntary "Office Weekend Workshop" for interns, new hires, and anyone who wants a focused deep-dive day. 9:30a-4:00p at SF hub. RSVP by Aug 10.

Diego: Nice. Will there be AC + quiet rooms? I need a place to run a small coding pairing session.

Sara (People Ops): Yep  main floor will be reserved, plus two quiet rooms. AC confirmed. Bring headphones if you want privacy.

Nina (Eng): Food situation? Im vegetarian.

Sara (People Ops): Lunch + snacks provided. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options available. Add dietary notes on the RSVP form.

FacilitiesBot: Shuttle: one roundtrip from downtown at 08:45 -> 17:30. Capacity 20, book via DeskReserve -> "Weekend Workshop" tag. Parking: limited; street parking permit valid for that day.

Diego: Can I bring a guest mentor from our partner company?

Sara (People Ops): External guests are allowed but must be pre-approved and registered for a visitor badge. Submit visitor requests by Aug 10. Hosts are responsible for guests while on-site.

Nina: Will remote folks have a virtual room? My teammate is remote and wants to join the intro session.

Sara (People Ops): We'll stream the intro + lightning talks. Reserve the "Hybrid Workshop" room to auto-provision the call. Add the tag "hybrid" in the booking.

CalendarBot: Event created "Office Weekend Workshop  Aug 21" by Sara. RSVP: https://intranet.redwood/events/1775554321

Sara (People Ops): TL;DR: Aug 21 optional workshop, RSVP by Aug 10, shuttle & limited parking, lunch provided, guests need badges, hybrid stream available. Ping People Ops with questions. :coffee:
